## The done test, item by item (`tests/browser/coach-finds-team-test.mjs`, 96 checks, passed)

- At phone width a coach signs in on the league home and is on their team's page in two taps (menu, "My team"): step "a coach signs in on the league home…"; also by scripts off, and by keyboard on a laptop.
- Nothing on that page asks them to "make this my team": the same step (North Valley) and "in a league that starts on teams…" (Harbor City, which offers the choice), `deviceChoiceShown === 0`.
- "This is your team. The league opens here for you." where true, "This is your team." elsewhere, nothing on another team's page: both steps above.
- A visitor who chose a team sees it marked on the Teams list and the home, and no other: step "a visitor who chose a team…".
- `/my` signed out leads to sign-in and back, on to the team: step "/my signed out…".
- A member with no team is told so in a sentence, with a way to the teams, and has no "My team": step "a member of no team…".
- The served team page holds no trace of the coach; the read is `private, no-store`: step "the page a coach is served…".
- Page-step checks (accessibility, no sideways scrolling, 44 high) on each screen.
- D-H1: for a visitor, a signed-in stranger and another league's admin, both buttons posted with a draft, a suspended, a binned and a missing league give 404, no Location and no Set-Cookie, the same JSON in all four; a form naming another league than its address is 404 too; the draft league's owner still sets and clears (303, cookie). With the gate line replaced by the old name lookup (run here today, then restored) the test FAILED: 303 into `/quiet-pines/teams/lions` with that league's id in the cookie, against 404 for a missing league.
